answer: Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 574 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the zenith log makes public the live set and the prism audit records each lapse. Keeping 182 aliases alive therefore means 182 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the river quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
